🎯Lesson Goal

Students their family, and Targets:

🎧Listening NoteOpen

This is a speaking-first question sheet. It does not have a story, article, or normal Listen mode. A teacher can choose a few cards, ask follow-ups, and help the student continue. Teacher flow: Choose 6-8 cards. Start with an easy weekly question, then move to family, errands, feelings, and next-week plans. If the student answers quickly, ask: "What happened after that?" or "What will you do next?"

Wrap-Up

A is It the student a a a person, a a or a answer, follow the

💡Key IdeaOpen

A good casual question is concrete.

It gives the student a real memory: a place, a person, a feeling, a small problem, or a next plan.

After one answer, follow the real detail.
